entries.zh: 饱足；因过量而腻厌、生厌
entries.en: sated, full; to be cloyed or fed up (from excess)
entries.notes: R 栏空；音写 bŭ iām 近「無厭/不厭」，与词头 harto 的肯定义相反，故仅据汉字 厭 立义。

entries.zh: 饱足而满足；称心（吃得满足）
entries.en: satisfied, content; filled and pleased
entries.notes: 懨 非通行字，疑为 慊（满足）或 饜 之讹；quîam quâm cuây 三音节未能逐字对应。

entries.zh: 饱胀；充足丰盛（吃得极饱而胀）
entries.en: gorged, bloated (with food); abundantly full
satisfied and pleased; content after eating one's fill
entries.notes: 懨快 非通行词，据 harto satisfecho 与音写 quîam cuây 推为 慊快（满足称意）。

entries.en: full, replete; plentiful

entries.zh: 吃得太饱、撑饱；饱食过量
entries.en: to eat one's fill; to overeat, stuff oneself
entries.notes: 傷 借作闽南语 siuⁿ「太、过」，食傷飽＝吃得太饱。

entries.zh: 吃得满到嘴边；极饱欲呕
entries.en: so full that the food rises to the mouth; gorged to the throat
entries.notes: 汉字作「口」，音写 chûy 为「嘴」，所指同一。

entries.zh: 到、至（hasta）；末尾例语污损不可读
entries.en: to, until, as far as; the trailing example is illegible
entries.notes: 两处 T99 污损落在例语 chiong xūn 上，仅核心 到＝hasta 可定，例语义不能定。

entries.en: to reach; up to; and
to; until; reaching to

entries.zh: 直到那里（至彼处）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: up to there; as far as that place 〔fragmentary original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅一破折号、音写栏空，对音 vol noh 难辨，仅西语 hasta allí 可据。

entries.en: to the end; to exhaustion

entries.zh: 足：足够、够用（够过活所需）
entries.en: sufficient; enough (for one's needs)
enough to eat; sufficient to get by
entries.notes: p.a＝para 之缩写，不影响释义。

entries.en: having enough food; sufficient provisions

entries.zh: 到过日：够维持生计、勉强度日
entries.en: enough to live on; sufficient to get through the days
until now; up to the present
to the very end; to the utmost
finally; in the end; to the last
entries.notes: 終然 非经见合成词（或为 終焉 之讹），音写 xīen 对应 然，义仍随 hasta el fin。

entries.zh: 到底：到最底下、直至地面；彻底
entries.en: to the bottom; down to the ground; thoroughly
all; wholly; to finish, complete
entries.notes: 西语「como de randa, acada」疑有讹脱，难据以定具体用法；音写 cûa 与 畢 常读不谐。
